Diagnosis.submission: The search deployment is down (0/1 replicas) because a ResourceQuota named memory-limit-quota with a hard memory limit of 1Gi was applied to the hotel-reservation namespace. The search container (hotel-reserv-search) does not specify memory limits or requests in its resource configuration (only CPU limits are defined). Kubernetes quota admission control requires that all containers specify memory resources when a memory quota is set in the namespace. This causes all pod creation attempts for the search deployment to be rejected with the error: failed quota memory-limit-quota must specify memory for hotel-reserv-search. The search service is completely unavailable, which breaks the hotel reservation application functionality.
